title: 第二百三十三章 煞侵禁地血醒凡脉第二百三十二章 冰殿抽芽神域起澜
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡骨镇天正文第二百三十三章煞侵禁地·血醒凡脉（..la）玄冥长老退入阴影时，袖中抖落一缕灰气。
那气无色无味，像神域终年不散的冷雾，却是太上忘情道压了十万年的“忘情煞”——是历代修忘情道失败的弟子，怨气凝成的死物，专克凡俗生气，碰着凡血就凝，沾着甜香就僵，最妙的是它无形无质，不会惊动神帝的神念，刚好能绕过刚下的禁地旨意。
冰殿里的暖痕，就是被这缕煞气冻住的。
陈默刚劈完第九十九刀，柴刀嵌在冰缝里，暖橙色的刀气正顺着冰纹往殿外渗，忽然手腕一僵——冰缝里的血珠瞬间结了霜，刀身上的歪草叶纹暗得像块死铁。他抬头，看见殿顶垂下来的冰棱正以肉眼可见的速度覆上白霜，那株刚抽了两片嫩叶的祖界草，叶尖瞬间蔫了，像被开水烫过的凡间青菜。
“煞气。”云清瑶的声音冷了一瞬，她指尖刚凝起的紫色灵气，碰到那缕灰气，瞬间冻成了冰碴。她心口那道刚松动的道伤，又开始针扎似的疼，比之前任何一次都凶。她下意识把陈默往身后护，袖中的玉佩却突然烫了一下——是里面藏的半块糖糕，正隔着玉质往外散甜香。
“怕个球。”陈默啐了一口，虎口裹着的冰蚕丝早被血浸透了，暗得像他刀身上的草叶纹。他没去硬抗那煞气，反而把柴刀从冰缝里拔出来，侧耳听了听——那煞气看似无形，飘动时却有极淡的波动，像他当年劈柴时，木头纤维断裂前的细微颤动。“这玩意儿跟木头茬子一个德行，看着硬，顺着茬子撬就碎。”
他咧嘴笑了，沾着血的柴刀顺着煞气的波动劈下去，不是硬砍，是像劈老树根上的分叉，刀刃贴着煞气的波动走，每劈一刀，就撬出一丝缝隙。暖橙色的凡气顺着缝隙钻进去，和煞气撞在一起，居然发出“滋啦”的轻响，像冷水滴进了热油锅。冰殿里的白霜以刀刃为中心，开始一点点消融，露出底下暖橙色的冰面。
“阿卯，扫你的冰。”
殿外突然传来一声极轻的呵斥。是个穿灰布短打的小仙童，十四五岁，脸冻得发青，正拿着扫帚扫殿门的冰。他是阿卯，祖上原是神帝当樵夫时的邻居，当年跟着上了神域，被太上忘情道洗了记忆，世代做扫洒仙童，连笑都不会，只知道每天把冰扫得干干净净，不能有半点杂质。
可今天，他的扫帚刚碰到陈默劈出的暖痕，指尖就猛地一烫。那不是灵气的灼烫，是像碰到了刚出锅的糖糕，暖得他心口发颤。一段早就忘了的记忆突然涌上来：七岁那年，奶奶在灶边蒸糖糕，白汽熏得她满脸都是，她把刚出锅的、烫得直吸气的糖糕塞进他手里，笑着说“阿卯乖，热乎的才叫甜”。
“甜……”阿卯喃喃着，手里的扫帚“哐当”掉在地上。他抬头，看见殿门缝隙里那抹嫩绿色的祖界草，忽然咧嘴笑了——那是神域十万年没出现过的笑容，嘴角扯出的弧度不标准，带着点傻气，却亮得晃眼。扫过十万年的冰，他第一次觉得，冰不是冷的，是暖的。
云清瑶看着阿卯的笑，心口那道疼了万年的道伤，忽然像被温水泡开的冻疮，彻底松了。她没再调动仙法，而是学着陈默的样子，指尖凝起一滴自己的神血，混着玉佩里渗出来的糖糕甜香，顺着陈默劈出的刀气缝隙送过去。神血是滚烫的，混着甜香，像一团烧红的炭，落进忘情煞的灰气里。
“轰——”
一声极轻的闷响，忘情煞的灰气瞬间被冲散，暖流顺着冰殿的地脉往四面八方窜。冰殿里的暖痕暴涨三倍，连殿顶的冰棱都化成了水，滴在地上“滴答”作响。那株祖界草更是疯长，瞬间抽了三寸高，第三片叶子上带着和陈默刀身上一模一样的歪草叶纹，在冷冽的灵气里晃得扎眼。
阴影里的玄冥长老脸色骤变。他活了十万年，见过无数仙法神通，却从未见过这样的“破局”——没有灵韵，没有道法，只是一个凡人顺着煞气的波动劈柴，一个神女学着凡人的样子送血，就把他引以为傲的忘情煞搅得稀烂。更让他心惊的是阿卯的笑——那是被太上忘情道洗得干干净净的凡脉，居然被一丝凡气就唤醒了，这比任何神通都可怖。
他刚要现身，一道混沌的神念就压了下来，像万丈玄冰，冻得他神魂发颤。是神帝。
神帝坐在九龙殿里，指尖还捏着那半块干硬的糖糕，眸子里映着冰殿里的景象：陈默劈柴的背影，云清瑶送血的动作，阿卯傻气的笑，还有那株晃得欢实的祖界草。他忽然想起三万年前，自己还是樵夫的时候，邻居奶奶也给他塞过这样的糖糕，他当时嫌烫，吹了半天，现在才明白，那点烫，才是活着的滋味。
“玄冥，退下。”神帝的神念传过去，带着不容置疑的威压，“敢动禁地半片叶子，朕拆了你这十万年的道行。”
玄冥长老脸色铁青，却不敢违逆。他退走时，袖中抖落一枚黑色的种子，落在禁地边缘的灵土里。那种子刚落地，就扎进了土里，抽出一片黑得发亮的叶子，叶子上带着和祖界草相反的、扭曲的草叶纹，散发着死气沉沉的冷意——是“灭世草种”，他当年从凡间带过来的，专门克祖界草的毒种。
冰殿里，陈默把柴刀往冰上一杵，抹了把脸上的汗，咧嘴笑了：“这破煞气，跟俺村头老张头劈的歪柴火一个德行，顺着茬子一撬就碎。”他没看见殿外那株黑草，只看见阿卯还在傻笑，云清瑶的脸色比之前红润了些，那株祖界草晃得正欢。

云清瑶走到殿门口，看着阿卯的笑，又看了看禁地边缘那抹不起眼的黑草，指尖轻轻碰了碰仙衣下摆的草叶印。她没说什么，只是从袖里掏出一块新的糖糕——是她偷偷学着王婆的样子蒸的，歪歪扭扭的，糖霜厚薄不均，递给了阿卯。
阿卯接过，咬了一口，烫得直吸气，却笑得更欢了。
神帝在九龙殿里，看着这一幕，指尖的糖糕终于被捏碎了。碎屑落在地上，居然长出了一抹嫩绿色的草芽，和他梦里的那株，一模一样。
而阴影里的烈阳神将，正默默看着这一切。他看着阿卯的笑，看着云清瑶手里的歪糖糕，看着陈默那把沾着血的柴刀，忽然觉得，自己修了万年的仙道，好像缺了点什么。
风卷着糖糕的甜香掠过神域，吹得那株黑草的叶子晃了晃，死气里，混进了一丝极淡的甜。..la

Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 233 of the main text of Mortal Bones Suppresses the Sky: Evil Invades the Forbidden Land·Blood Awakens the Mortal Vein (..la) When Elder Xuanming retreated into the shadows, a wisp of gray air fell from his sleeves.
That gas is colorless and odorless, like the cold mist that persists all year round in the divine realm, but it is the "Wangqing Evil" that has been suppressed for hundreds of thousands of years by the Supreme Wangqing Dao. It is a dead thing made of resentment by the disciples who have failed to practice the Wangqing Dao.
The warm marks in the ice palace were frozen by this evil spirit.
Chen Mo had just finished the ninety-ninth chop. The hatchet was embedded in the crevices of the ice. Warm orange sword energy was seeping out of the hall along the ice lines. Suddenly, his wrist stiffened - the blood beads in the ice crevices were instantly frosted, and the crooked grass leaf patterns on the blade were as dark as dead iron. He looked up and saw that the icy edges hanging down from the roof of the palace were covered with hoarfrost at a speed visible to the naked eye. The leaves of the ancestral grass that had just taken off two young leaves suddenly withered, like a mortal green vegetable that had been scalded by boiling water.
"Evil spirit." Yun Qingyao's voice was cold for a moment. The purple spiritual energy that had just condensed on her fingertips instantly froze into ice when it touched the gray air. The newly loosened wound on her heart began to hurt like needles again, worse than ever before. She subconsciously protected Chen Mo behind her, but the jade pendant in her sleeve suddenly became hot - it was half a piece of candy cake hidden inside, and the sweet fragrance was spreading out through the jade.
"Afraid of a ball." Chen Mo spat. The ice silk wrapped around the tiger's mouth was soaked with blood and was as dark as the grass blade pattern on his knife. Instead of resisting the evil aura, he pulled out the hatchet from the crack in the ice and listened - the evil aura seemed invisible, but there were very faint fluctuations when it floated, just like the subtle vibrations before the wood fibers broke when he was chopping firewood. "This thing has the same characteristics as wood stubble. It looks hard, but it will break if you pry along the stubble."
He grinned, and the blood-stained hatchet struck along with the waves of the evil spirit. It was not a hard cut, but like splitting the branches on the roots of an old tree. The blade followed the waves of the evil spirit, and every time it struck, a slight gap was opened. The warm orange mortal air got in along the gap and collided with the evil air, making a soft "sizzling" sound, like cold water dripping into a hot oil pan. The white frost in the ice palace began to melt little by little with the blade as the center, revealing the warm orange ice underneath.
"Amao, sweep away your ice."
Suddenly, a very light scolding came from outside the hall. He was a little fairy boy in gray cloth. He was fourteen or fifteen years old. His face was blue from the cold. He was sweeping the ice from the palace door with a broom. He is A Mao. His ancestor was the neighbor of the God Emperor when he was a woodcutter. He followed him to the Divine Realm back then, but his memory was washed away by the Supreme Being Wangqingdao. He has been a sweeping and sprinkling fairy boy for generations. He can't even smile. He only knows to sweep the ice clean every day without any impurities.
But today, as soon as his broom touched the warm mark made by Chen Mo, his fingertips suddenly felt hot. It wasn't the burning heat of spiritual energy, it was like touching a candy cake that had just come out of the pan, and it was so warm that it made his heart tremble. A long-forgotten memory suddenly came back: when she was seven years old, her grandma was steaming sugar cakes by the stove, and the white steam covered her face. She put the freshly hot sugar cakes into his hands and said with a smile, "My dear, only when it's hot is it sweet."
"Sweet..." Ah Mao murmured, and the broom in his hand fell to the ground with a clang. He raised his head and saw the tender green ancestral grass in the gap of the palace door, and suddenly grinned - it was a smile that had not appeared in the God's Domain for a hundred thousand years. The curve of the corners of his mouth was not standard, with a bit of stupidity, but it was dazzling. After sweeping through the 100,000-year-old ice, he felt for the first time that the ice was not cold, but warm.
Yun Qingyao looked at A Mao's smile, and the wound in his heart that had been hurting for thousands of years suddenly relaxed completely like frostbite soaked in warm water. She did not use the immortal magic anymore, but imitated Chen Mo. She condensed a drop of her own divine blood on her fingertips, mixed with the sweet scent of the sugar cake oozing out from Yu Perry, and followed Chen Mo's knife aura.Send it through the gap. The divine blood is hot, mixed with sweet fragrance, like a ball of red-hot coals, falling into the gray air of forgetfulness.
"Boom——"
There was a very light muffled sound, and the gloomy air of forgetfulness was instantly washed away, and warm currents rushed in all directions along the veins of the Ice Palace. The warmth in the ice palace surged three times, and even the ice edges on the roof of the palace turned into water, dripping on the ground with a "tick-tock" sound. The ancestral grass grew even more crazily, reaching three inches in height in an instant. The third leaf had the same crooked grass leaf pattern as Chen Mo Dao's, which was dazzling in the cold spiritual energy.
Elder Xuan Ming's expression in the shadow suddenly changed. He has lived for a hundred thousand years and has seen countless immortal magic and magical powers, but he has never seen such a "broken situation" - no aura, no Taoism, just a mortal chopping firewood along with the fluctuation of the evil spirit, and a goddess imitating a mortal to send blood, which destroyed the Wangqing evil that he was proud of. What frightened him even more was A Mao's smile - it was the mortal veins that had been cleansed by the Supreme Forgetfulness Dao, but was actually awakened by a trace of mortal energy. This was more terrifying than any magical power.
Just as he was about to show up, a chaotic spiritual thought came down, like ten thousand feet of black ice, making his soul tremble with cold. It's the God Emperor.
The God Emperor was sitting in the Nine Dragons Palace, still holding the half piece of hard candy cake with his fingertips. His eyes reflected the scene in the Ice Palace: Chen Mo's back chopping firewood, Yun Qingyao's movement of sending blood, Ah Mao's silly smile, and the swaying ancestral grass. He suddenly remembered that 30,000 years ago, when he was a woodcutter, his neighbor's grandmother also stuffed him with such candy cakes. He thought it was too hot at the time, so he blew it for a long time. Only now did he realize that that hotness is what it feels like to be alive.
"Xuan Ming, step back." The divine will of the God Emperor passed over, with unquestionable pressure, "If you dare to touch half a leaf in the forbidden area, I will destroy your hundred thousand years of Taoism."
Elder Xuan Ming's face was ashen, but he did not dare to disobey. As he retreated, a black seed fell from his sleeve and fell into the spiritual soil at the edge of the forbidden area. As soon as the seed fell to the ground, it plunged into the soil and pulled out a shiny black leaf with twisted grass blade patterns that were opposite to those of the ancestral world grass. It exuded a lifeless coldness - it was the "World-Destroying Grass Seed", a poisonous seed that he had brought from the mortal world to defeat the ancestral world grass.
In the ice palace, Chen Mo slammed the hatchet onto the ice, wiped the sweat from his face, and grinned: "This evil spirit is the same as the crooked firewood chopped by my village head Zhang. It will break into pieces as soon as you pry along the stubble." He did not see the black grass outside the palace, only saw A Mao still giggling. Yun Qingyao's face was rosier than before, and the ancestral grass was shaking happily.
Yun Qingyao walked to the entrance of the palace, looked at A Mao's smile, then looked at the inconspicuous black grass on the edge of the forbidden area, and lightly touched the grass leaf mark on the hem of the fairy clothes with her fingertips. She didn't say anything, she just took out a new piece of candy cake from her sleeve - she secretly imitated Wang Po's method of steaming it, it was crooked, the frosting was unevenly thick, and she handed it to Ah Mao.
Ah Mao took it and took a bite. It was so hot that he breathed in, but he smiled even more happily.
The God Emperor was in the Nine Dragons Palace. Watching this scene, the candy cake on his fingertips was finally crushed. The debris fell to the ground, and a tender green grass bud actually grew out, exactly like the one in his dream.
And Lieyang God General in the shadow was watching all this silently. He looked at Ah Mao's smile, looked at the crooked candy cake in Yun Qingyao's hand, looked at Chen Mo's bloody hatchet, and suddenly felt that something was missing in the immortal way he had cultivated for thousands of years.
The wind carried the sweet scent of sugar cakes across the divine realm, causing the leaves of the black grass to sway, and a trace of very faint sweetness was mixed into the dead air. ..la
